name: Valkey
author: grandpaacademy
description: Valkey - open source Redis fork. Drop-in replacement for Redis with enhanced performance and community governance.
startup: if [ ! -f /home/container/valkey.conf ]; then echo "port ${SERVER_PORT:-6379}" > /home/container/valkey.conf; echo "bind 0.0.0.0" >> /home/container/valkey.conf; echo "daemonize no" >> /home/container/valkey.conf; if [ ! -z "${VALKEY_PASSWORD}" ]; then echo "requirepass ${VALKEY_PASSWORD}" >> /home/container/valkey.conf; fi; fi; exec valkey-server /home/container/valkey.conf

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Valkey Install Script
apt update
apt install -y curl jq
mkdir -p /mnt/server
echo -e "install complete"
exit 0

variables.name: Valkey Password
variables.description: Password for Valkey authentication. Leave blank for no password.
